K.H. GURUPRASAD

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India | gururao_kh@outlook.com | 9916947414 
 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Immediately available to join 
 
Results-driven Senior Business Analyst with 18 years of expertise in Capital Markets, Payments, and Investment Banking 
operations, specializing in trade lifecycle management, reconciliation, and settlements. Proven success in bridging business 
and technology, driving transformation initiatives, and optimizing straight-through processing across global banking 
environments. Adept at eliciting complex requirements, conducting AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, and delivering scalable solutions 
under Agile and Waterfall methodologies. Recognized for reducing settlement fails, strengthening governance frameworks, 
and implementing KPI-driven dashboards for transparent decision-making. Experienced in leading cross-functional teams of up 
to 25 members, managing stakeholder expectations, and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards. Certified in Business 
Analysis, Agile, Power BI, SQL, SAP FI, and Leadership & Strategy, with a strong track record of delivering operational 
excellence and transformation in BFSI domains. 
 
KEY SKILLS 
• Business Analysis: Requirement Elicitation & Prioritization, BRD/FRD Documentation, User Stories, Use Cases, UML 
Diagrams, BPMN, Wireframes & Mockups, Gap Analysis, Scope Definition, AS-IS/TO-BE, Process Mapping, MoSCow. 
• Domain: Global Trading (Front, Middle & Back Office), Trade Matching & Settlement, Capital Markets, Payments, 
Reference & Static Data Governance, Claims Management, Regulatory Compliance, Reconciliation. 
• Delivery Methodology: Agile & Scrum, Waterfall, SDLC, Sprint Planning & Review, Product Backlog Management, 
Release Planning, Change Request Management, UAT & Hypercare Support 
• Data & Reporting: SQL, Power BI (KPI Dashboards), Data Dictionary, Logical Data Model, RAID Log Management, MS 
Excel (Advanced) 
• Leadership: Stakeholder Management, Cross-Functional Team Leadership (up to 25 members), Vendor & Client 
Communication, Risk & Control Assessment, Project Documentation & Governance 
• Tools: Jira, Confluence, MS Visio, Lucidchart, Balsamiq, SAP FI, SQL, Power BI, 
 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Accenture, Bangalore 
Associate Manager (Senior Business Analyst) - Reconciliation Dec 2025 – Jul 2026 
 
• Led business analysis for a high-volume Cash, Trade and general ledger reconciliation transformation project, aligning 
stakeholders across finance, compliance, and engineering 
• Supervised a 25-member team through mobilization and requirement-gathering workshops and stakeholder interviews 
(interviews, questionnaires, interface/document analysis, brainstorming, focus groups) to ensure full coverage of business 
needs. 
• Configured and tested auto-matching and auto-allocation rules, improving daily matching efficiency to 95% to 100% on-
time transaction matching, trade matching, and settlement through rigorous reconciliation of internal and external data and 
strengthened reference/static data governance. 
• Facilitated requirement workshops with operational users to translate complex manual adjustment practices into structured 
system rules. 
• Facilitated daily stand-up governance forums on Jira to track milestones, align cross-functional teams, escalate blockers, 
and assess readiness for automating manual activities.

• Introduced process improvements, including an internal contact management tool, reducing reliance on external data

• Partnered with cross-functional teams across development, integration, and UAT, ensuring quality delivery and seamless 
transition into BAU.
